edges.label: Minot 1968 extends the pattern with instrumented detection
edges.note: Where Malmstrom 1967 is a documented shutdown with contested causation, Minot 1968 adds ground radar, airborne radar, weather radar, visual observation, a four-minute radio failure and physical security alarms at Minuteman silos.

edges.label: Blue Book declined to field-investigate an instrumented nuclear-site case
edges.note: The RADCAT directory records that Project Blue Book personnel did not send field investigators and the incident was written off despite interest from SAC generals including 15th Air Force's Maj. Gen. Nichols.
